candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders; gateway checkout propagates these as 502s. Traces show order 500s within each checkout correlation, and gateway metrics show 16 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs and dependency metrics were not admitted, so the internal cause of the order 500s (db, redis, payment) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces tie each gateway 502 on /v1/checkout to an order-service 500 on /v1/orders, and gateway metrics confirm elevated 502s on checkout. The bounded candidate is order-service HTTP 500s surfacing as gateway 502s; the deeper dependency cause remains unproven, so it is left as uncertainty rather than a separate candidate.
missing_evidence: Order service logs or traces showing the internal error behind the 500 responses
Order dependency operation metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
